sources.summary: Dutch studio Bastiaan Jongerius Architecten has transformed a 1970s farmhouse outside Amsterdam, extending its timber structure and updating its exterior with black-metal panels and charred wood. Named Longhouse Farm, the timber-and-brick farmhouse in Zunderdorp was originally slated for demolition until Bastiaan Jongerius Architecten opted to retain and extend it.
